name: atrium
description: Open-source remote browser infrastructure for embeddable Chromium sessions

scripts.pack:check: rm -rf .packs && mkdir -p .packs && pnpm --dir packages/protocol pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/core pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/express pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/react pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/worker pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/cli pack --pack-destination ../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/legacy-shims/atrium-protocol pack --pack-destination ../../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/legacy-shims/atrium-server pack --pack-destination ../../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/legacy-shims/atrium-react pack --pack-destination ../../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/legacy-shims/atrium-worker pack --pack-destination ../../../.packs && pnpm --dir packages/legacy-shims/atrium-cli pack --pack-destination ../../../.packs
scripts.publish:check: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm pack:check
